verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships an official Python package and scripting API for controlling and extending the terminal: custom status bar components, triggers, menu items, or entirely new features. Triggers and the status bar can invoke Python, and AppleScript support is also available. A community user corroborates the Python API with a working theme-switching script. Missing for 10: in-depth evidence of API breadth and limits (e.g., script distribution/packaging, deeper hands-on reports beyond a single user anecdote).
